test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a freshwater lake in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sambhar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sambhar is not a freshwater lake in India, but rather a saltwater lake located in Rajasthan****.**
 
• Sambhar Lake is the largest brackish water lake in Rajasthan and the second largest in the country (the first being Chilka Lake, Odisha).
 
• Sambhar Lake receives water from five rivers:-
 
 
• Medha River
 
• Mantha River
 
• Khari River
 
• Khandela River
 
• Rupangarh River
 
 
 
• Bhimtal is a freshwater lake located in the Nainital district of Uttarakhand.
 
• Loktak is a freshwater lake located in Manipur and is the l**argest freshwater lake in Northeast India**.
 
• Barapani, also known as Umiam Lake, is a freshwater lake located in **Meghalaya and is a popular tourist destination.**
 
• India has numerous freshwater lakes, including **Dal Lake in Jammu and Kashmir, and Vembanad Lake in Kerala, among others.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bhimtal is situated at an altitude of 1,370 meters and is surrounded by **lush green hills.**
 
• Loktak Lake is known for its floating islands, called phumdis, which are made up of **vegetation and organic matter**.
 
• Barapani is a man-made lake that was created by building a** dam on the Umiam River.**
 
• Sambhar Lake is a saltwater lake and is the largest inland salt lake in India. It is also an important** wetland and bird sanctuary.**
